secrets.name: FIREBASE_CREDENTIALS
secrets.description: Firebase service account JSON on a single line: Firebase console -> Project settings -> Service accounts -> Generate new private key. Used by the API for push notifications and to verify login tokens. The sandbox generates a throwaway service account when this is empty so the API can boot, but nothing is actually delivered until a real key is supplied.

secrets.name: GCP_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: Google Cloud / Firebase project id, must match the project the service account belongs to.

secrets.name: FIREBASE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase web app config value apiKey (Firebase console -> Project settings -> General -> Your apps -> Web app). Needed for the web login page.

secrets.name: FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN
secrets.description: Firebase web app config value authDomain (same web app config as FIREBASE_API_KEY).

secrets.name: FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: Firebase web app config value projectId.

secrets.name: FIREBASE_APP_ID
secrets.description: Firebase web app config value appId.

secrets.name: FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID
secrets.description: Firebase web app config value messagingSenderId.

secrets.name: FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET
secrets.description: Firebase web app config value storageBucket.

secrets.name: SMTP_HOST
secrets.description: SMTP server host used for outgoing email (e.g. smtp.mailtrap.io).

secrets.name: SMTP_USERNAME
secrets.description: SMTP username from your email provider.

secrets.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
secrets.description: SMTP password from your email provider.

secrets.name: SMTP_FROM_EMAIL
secrets.description: From address for outgoing email, must be allowed by your SMTP provider.

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key (Cloudflare dashboard -> Turnstile), validates the captcha on message search.

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY
secrets.description: Cloudflare Turnstile site key for the same widget, used by the web search page.
